cluster: Shared local PD/TiKV and Go TiDB v9.0.0-beta.2.pre-nightly

large_input_guard.sql: SELECT SUM(lo),SUM(hi),COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT c,MIN(k) AS lo,MAX(k) AS hi FROM sbtest1 GROUP BY c) AS g
large_input_guard.notes: Alternating before/after runs after warm-up; every answer equals Go. EXPLAIN confirms full-scan partial/final grouped HashAgg, retaining MIN/MAX so unused aggregate elimination cannot turn it into a cardinality shortcut. No meaningful change is established by the 0.17% median difference; this is one large-input guard, not all large aggregation shapes.

tpcc_guard.conclusion: No TPC-C speedup established: small median increases have inconsistent paired directions and time-seeded transaction mixes on a shared evolving dataset.
